abstract: Eighteen men presenting with metastatic germ-cell malignancy in whom no primary tumour could be palpated in either testis are described. All patients had both testes in the scrotal sac and none had a history of maldescent. All had abdominal node involvement, in most cases associated with metastases at other sites. Ten men presented with Stage 4 disease, five with Stage 3 and three with Stage 2. The most common histological sub-type associated with an occult primary testicular tumour was trophoblastic malignant teratoma (9/18 patients). Abdominal pain (12 patients) and systemic symptoms (10 patients) were common presenting features. There was a history of testicular atrophy in eight patients and seven had experienced episodes of transient testicular pain up to 18 months before presentation. In three of four patients in whom the testis was examined histologically following a history of atrophy and/or pain, there was evidence of a primary tumour, manifest as spontaneous tumour regression (one), differentiation (one) or a small micro-primary trophoblastic teratoma (one). In a fifth patient an ultrasonic scan showed a 1-cm echogenic mass in an atrophic testis. In 10 patients the diagnosis of germ-cell malignancy was established by laparotomy. Obstructive uropathy was present in six patients, associated with haematuria in four patients.
abstract_ja: 精巣のいずれにも原発腫瘍を触知しなかった、転移性胚細胞悪性腫瘍の男性18例を報告する。両精巣は陰嚢内にあり、停留の既往はなかった。全例で腹部リンパ節転移があり、10例はStage 4、5例はStage 3、3例はStage 2であった。原発精巣腫瘍を伴う組織型として最も多かったのは栄養膜性悪性奇形腫（9/18例）であった。腹痛（12例）と全身症状（10例）が一般的な初発症状であった。精巣萎縮の既往が8例、18か月前までの一過性の精巣痛が7例にみられた。精巣萎縮や疼痛の既往があった4例のうち3例で精巣を組織学的に検討したところ、自然退縮（1例）、分化（1例）、微小な栄養膜性奇形腫（1例）として原発巣の存在が示された。5例目では、萎縮した精巣に1cmの高エコー性腫瘤が超音波で認められた。10例は開腹術により胚細胞悪性腫瘍と診断された。尿路閉塞が6例にみられ、うち4例で血尿を伴った。
